The injured were taken to Combined Military Hospital Kohat as security forces cordoned off the area and began a search operation.

His family confirmed the death, and his mother, Suzanne Sheik, told The New York Times that organ failure was the cause. The loss ends a career that moved from a durable pop hit to acclaimed Broadway work, while a planned Off-Broadway “Spring Awakening” production had yet to announce any changes.
